mapper.update: UPDATE raw_material_lot SET available_qty=available_qty+#{quantity},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE raw_lot_id=#{rawLotId} AND #{quantity} > 0 AND #{quantity} <= 999999999999.999999-available_qty AND #{quantity} <= registered_qty-available_qty
mapper.select: SELECT receipt_id,scope_key,operation_code,request_key,payload_fingerprint,initial_outcome_snapshot AS snapshot,processed_at,created_by FROM request_receipt WHERE scope_key=#{scopeKey} AND operation_code='MATERIAL_RETURN' AND request_key=#{requestKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE request_receipt SET initial_outcome_snapshot=#{snapshot},processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId} AND operation_code='MATERIAL_RETURN' AND processed_at IS NULL AND initial_outcome_snapshot IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_consumption WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_return WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_result WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_inspection WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId})
